title: Scanner and Faction Ops
summary: Turns Lens scan results, HoloMap POIs, faction contact rules, drone readouts, and cache rewards into a readable field workflow.
nextSteps: Scan from shelter before committing to a route.
Open the linked Index entry when Lens reports a faction or cache signal.
Treat faction markers as contact leads unless a mission says otherwise.
Claim cache loot only after the scan and HoloMap marker agree on the route state.
Use drone HUD warnings as route pressure, not as raw debug telemetry.

panels.title: Scanner Read
panels.body: Lens rows must name the risk, linked mission, Index entry, and HoloMap marker so a signal becomes a decision.

panels.title: Faction Contact
panels.body: Crashbreak and Radwarden contacts start as observation, standing, and optional contract work.

panels.title: Cache Reward
panels.body: Cache rewards should present supplies, route notes, and reputation context before the player claims them.
